title: DENR starts restoring wetlands, rivers critical for El Niño

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) launched a nationwide ecosystem restoration program focusing on critical wetlands, rivers, and coral reefs to protect communities against the impacts of extreme dry heat expected from the onset of a very strong El Niño. “We are ensuring that our ecosystems remain functional buffers against extreme heat. Protecting our wetlands, rivers, and reefs nationwide is one way of protecting the communities and ensuring environmental survival,” Secretary Juan Miguel “Mitch” Cuna stressed in a DENR statement issued on Thursday. “By extracting nearly 100 metric tons of waste from Manila Bay tributaries, preserving […]...
